title: Olongapo heat index reaches 44.8°C, remains at danger level

blocks.text: OLONGAPO CITY— The city continued to experience dangerously high heat levels on Sunday, Oct. 25, as the heat index in Barangay Barretto climbed to 44.8 degrees Celsius, according to the City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO). The reading, recorded on Sunday morning, placed the area under the “danger” category of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa). Meanwhile, the monitoring station in Barangay Old Cabalan registered a heat index of 40.5°C as of 10:35 a.m., falling under the “extreme caution” category.
